Amazing food, service and atmosphere
Jan 2026 • Couples
This restaurant is an amazing choice for a luxury feeling dinner with some amazing traditional vietnamese dishes. The food tasted incredible, but especially the staff was very nice. Venn didn’t just take the extra step, he absolutely went the extra mile to make sure we were as comfortable as possible. He gave good recommendations, explained me how to eat the dish i ordered: ‘bún cha’ like a local and gave a lot of extra information about the food and origins. The drinks the bartender named “whiskey” for us were also incredibly delicious. Definitely recommend having dinner here:)

I highly recommend this place!
